description: Chronicle dependency intake (docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md). Self-hosted: scripts/renovate-run.sh runs this file as the global
config for every repository (requireConfig=ignored), so a stale renovate.json on another branch never applies.
Waits: 7 days routine, 14 days major, 3 days security; no timestamp means no update (timestamp-required).
Renovate only edits the pins and pushes renovate/* branches: it holds the GitHub token, so it runs no package
manager (skipArtifactsUpdate; no postUpdateOptions) and never merges (automerge false). Lockfiles, go.sum and
derived pins are regenerated in the dependency sandbox by scripts/deps-regenerate.py, and deps/auto moves only
when scripts/dependency-gate-runner.py has gated a branch. Nothing here merges into main, publishes or tags.

debian-source.description: Debian source package versions from snapshot.debian.org. It carries no release time, so timestamp-required never proposes one; the age gate dates a changed pin by first_seen

packageRules.description: Major updates wait 14 days; the gate runner still decides the merge
Gate tool bumps need the per-platform digests in toolchain-manifest.yaml and the versions in scripts/local-ci.sh refreshed by hand
A version RUN lines fetch sits next to a checksum, commit or buildstamp that is refreshed by hand with it; the image build fails until it is
debianutils is built at the version the upstream backup image ships (selfhost/Dockerfile.backup); it moves with that upstream commit

go-jose v3 is replaced by a patched local copy (selfhost/Dockerfile.caddy); OSV proposes v4, a different module path. enabled:false does not stop Renovate's vulnerability branches (2026-11-08: renovate/go-github.com-go-jose-go-jose-v3-vulnerability rewrote caddy/module/go.mod to v4.0.0), so ignoreDeps above drops the module at extraction
Images this project publishes itself move with its own releases
Images built locally from this repository (localhost/...) have no registry to update from
A PostgreSQL major is a dump/restore migration (selfhost/docs/POSTGRES-18-UPGRADE.md), never an image swap
Android wrapper pairs with AGP in chronicle/ (toolchain-manifest.yaml: do not unify); chronicle-dev is not in the Renovate run
Flyway 12 changed licensing terms (toolchain-manifest.yaml freshness.accepted_behind)
Kotlin moves as one: Gradle plugins, stdlib forces and the toolchain manifest
Bun runtime: manifest pin and builder images move together
Gradle wrapper: root wrapper and manifest pin together (deps-regenerate.sh copies it into the JVM submodules)
